name: glitchr/omnilab
description: Omnilab: one contract for the public science-data APIs - entities (a compound, a gene, a protein, a species, a star, an earthquake) with their properties, units and cross-references, series (a variable measured at a place over time: weather, climate, air) and catalogued products (a satellite scene, a dataset, STAC-like) - whatever the domain; a Collector that follows cross-references from one base to the next, and a Symfony bundle.

suggest.omnilab/pubchem: PubChem: compounds by CID, name, InChIKey, CAS or SMILES, their computed properties, synonyms, structure image and cross-references
suggest.omnilab/open-meteo: Open-Meteo: hourly and daily weather series at a point, forecast and historical archive
suggest.omnilab/copernicus: Copernicus Data Space: Sentinel, Landsat and Copernicus service products from its STAC catalogue
suggest.omnilab/chebi: ChEBI: chemical entities by ChEBI id, InChIKey, CAS, KEGG or name, their structure, ontology (classes, roles) and cross-references
suggest.omnilab/wikidata: Wikidata: any item by Q-number, by a science base's identifier or by label, its labels in a language, its cross-references and a few properties with units
suggest.omnilab/chembl: ChEMBL: bioactive molecules by ChEMBL id, InChIKey or name, their development phase, computed properties, mechanisms of action and targets, cross-references from UniChem
suggest.omnilab/uniprot: UniProt: proteins of UniProtKB by accession or entry name, their function, gene, organism, sequence, mass, cofactors and ligands, their genes in NCBI and Ensembl
suggest.omnilab/ncbi: NCBI Gene and Taxonomy: genes by GeneID, taxa by id or name, their location, summary and lineage, their UniProt, Ensembl and GBIF ids
suggest.omnilab/gbif: GBIF: taxa of its taxonomy (the Catalogue of Life eXtended Release) by key, legacy Backbone number, NCBI id or scientific name, their status, IUCN category and lineage
suggest.omnilab/simbad: SIMBAD (CDS): objects beyond the solar system by any identifier, their type, coordinates, motion, parallax, velocity, redshift, spectral type and magnitudes
suggest.omnilab/jpl: NASA/JPL Small-Body Database: asteroids and comets by number, designation or name, their orbit, physical parameters, NEO and PHA flags, close approaches and impact risk
suggest.omnilab/usgs: USGS earthquake catalogue (ComCat): an earthquake by its id with its time and place, the earthquakes of a box or around a point as series
suggest.omnilab/ensembl: Ensembl: genes, transcripts, proteins and exons by Ensembl id, genes by symbol in a species, their place on the genome, biotype and assembly, their NCBI Gene and UniProt entries
suggest.omnilab/pdb: RCSB PDB: structures of the Protein Data Bank by PDB id, their method, resolution, citation, chains and ligands, their UniProt proteins and ligands as related things; a full-text search
suggest.omnilab/inaturalist: iNaturalist: taxa by id or name, their common name, IUCN status, lineage and default photo with its licence; the observations of a place and a period, research grade by default
suggest.symfony/config: In a Symfony application: the configuration of Omnilab\Bridge\Symfony\OmnilabBundle
suggest.symfony/dependency-injection: In a Symfony application: the services of Omnilab\Bridge\Symfony\OmnilabBundle
suggest.symfony/http-kernel: In a Symfony application: Omnilab\Bridge\Symfony\OmnilabBundle itself
